title: Enterprise Cloud Migration and Modernization Services

collectionStrategy.approach: Phased data collection aligned with capture lifecycle milestones. Pre-TA data calls focus on internal capabilities and public-domain intelligence. Post-TA data calls collect partner-specific information under NDA protection. All data calls tracked through GovHub with automated reminders and quality scoring.

phases.description: Internal capability assessment and public-domain intelligence gathering. No partner-proprietary data collected.
Partner capability data collection, workshare refinement, and joint solution development. Requires executed NDA and TA.
Targeted data collection for proposal volume content, pricing inputs, and past performance narratives.
Final data validation, accuracy checks, and representation certifications before submission.

qualityStandards.completeness: All required fields populated with source attribution
qualityStandards.accuracy: Data verified against two independent sources where possible
qualityStandards.currency: Information no older than 12 months unless historical trend data
qualityStandards.classification: All data handled at appropriate classification level

aiRecommendations.title: Missing FinOps Cost Savings Evidence
aiRecommendations.description: The Army Cloud Migration past performance narrative claims $12M in annual cost savings through FinOps optimization, but no independent verification or audit documentation has been collected to substantiate this figure. DHS OIG specifically highlighted cloud cost waste as a hot button — evaluators will scrutinize cost savings claims.
aiRecommendations.recommendation: Request Army COR to provide signed memo confirming $12M savings figure, or collect Army financial system reports showing before/after cloud spend. If independent verification unavailable, adjust claim to 'estimated $10-12M savings based on RI utilization improvement from 28% to 87%' with RI utilization dashboard screenshots as evidence.
aiRecommendations.impact: Unsubstantiated cost savings claims could be flagged as a weakness in Past Performance evaluation. DHS evaluators may downgrade if claims appear inflated.

aiRecommendations.title: Rachel Foster Resume Sanitization Review
aiRecommendations.description: Rachel Foster's resume has been sanitized to remove Peraton and current contract references, but three bullet points still reference 'DHS cloud migration support services' which, combined with her clearance level and years of experience, may allow evaluators to identify her current employer. This creates risk if incumbent protests our recruiting practices.
aiRecommendations.recommendation: Revise resume to use more generic descriptions: 'Federal civilian agency cloud infrastructure support' instead of 'DHS cloud migration support services.' Have legal counsel review final sanitized version. Prepare briefing for Contracting Officer if questioned about key personnel sourcing during discussions.
aiRecommendations.impact: If incumbent identifies Rachel Foster and files protest alleging improper recruiting, it could delay award or disqualify her as key personnel. Risk is low but consequence is high.

aiRecommendations.title: Partner Data Collection Timeline Risk
aiRecommendations.description: Three teaming partners need to provide capability statements, past performance packages, and pricing inputs, but only DataBridge Analytics has an executed NDA. GovFlow NDA is signed but TA pending. MainframeNext NDA is still in legal review. At current pace, partner data collection will not complete until March 5 — leaving only 10 days before expected RFP release for integration and quality review.
aiRecommendations.recommendation: Accelerate NDA/TA execution timeline: (1) Escalate MainframeNext NDA to priority legal review — target Feb 12 execution. (2) Issue GovFlow data call upon NDA signature, before TA execution, for non-proprietary items (capability statement, public PP data). (3) Prepare contingency: pre-draft partner sections using publicly available information (SAM.gov, FPDS) that can be refined when partner data arrives. (4) Schedule Feb 15 checkpoint: if MainframeNext NDA not signed, activate alternate partner (Astadia Federal).
aiRecommendations.impact: Late partner data creates proposal development bottleneck. Pricing volume cannot be completed without partner rates. Past performance volume requires partner PP narratives for team aggregate scoring.
